section_anchor: What the magnet does in this particular stem
brief_summary: Line chart of magnetic flux at the Hall sensor against stem travel for the Gateron Magnetic Jade. A coral curve starts at 120±15Gs at rest and rises, steepening, to 800±80Gs at the 3.5±0.2mm bottom-out. A dashed coral vertical with a double-headed arrow marks the firmware-set actuation point ('freely setting'); a coral bracket on the release side marks the rapid-trigger reset delta. Annotations note the curve is flat and least precise near rest, steep and most precise near the pole bottom-out.
